verdicts.evidence: Cold-start SFT, reflection SFT, and ATRL scripts exist with decomposed rewards, but the preprocessor raises NameError, ATRL uses placeholder data/model paths, KL is enabled contrary to the paper, and only 2 SFT and 2 RL records are released with the 64k corpus absent—no runnable training path is demonstrated.
The logbook states the trained Ophiuchus checkpoint, complete evaluation commands, benchmark inputs/splits, and baseline predictions are all absent; no benchmark was rerun.
No checkpoint or evaluation was run; the in-domain comparison against GPT-5 was not reproduced or tested in any form.
No checkpoint, benchmark data, or baseline predictions are available; the comparisons against VILA-M3-40B and MMedAgent-7B were not rerun.

Focused tests confirm three tool handlers, multi-image state, format/answer/tool rewards, and a local zoom path that yields reward 4.0 and final_won=true, but released SFT trajectories use an unparseable tool-call form, duplicate calls do not early-stop, and list-valued mask_path raises TypeError—partial functionality on a 2-trajectory subset with bugs.

overall: The logbook establishes that the released code contains a partial tool/reward core and all three training-stage scripts, but these are non-runnable due to placeholder paths, a broken preprocessor, parser mismatches, and missing data. No benchmark, checkpoint, or 64k corpus was available to test any performance or training claim, leaving most claims inconclusive.
